artifacts.notes: Identifies and dimensions one historical censer variation. Its cataloged body without chain is 24.6 cm high by 14.6 cm in diameter, with a separately measured lid and chain. It demonstrates variation only; its material, date, ornament, exact silhouette, and dimensions are not generalized.

work.description: The Metropolitan Museum of Art's cataloged Swiss censer made before 1477. It is a historical material-culture variation witness, not a normative Roman specification or a model for the generic teaching drawing.
